# Aseryx

> Get paid for your data without handing it over first. Aseryx licenses data to AI companies. Every dataset gets a quality certificate teams review before anything is shared.

## How it works

- The owner lists a dataset, and it gets a quality certificate.
- AI companies review the certificate, run a query and make an offer.
- The owner approves the offer and gets paid. Nothing else is shared until then.

## Terms for owners

- Nothing to list. Aseryx keeps 20% of each license, only when a team pays.
- A license runs for 3, 6, 9 or 12 months, as set in the offer the owner approves.
- Licenses are non-exclusive: owners can license the same dataset anywhere else.

## For AI companies

- The quality certificate shows what a dataset contains and how clean and well-structured it is, worked out from that exact data.
- Teams can query how much of the data meets their conditions, and get a count checked against the data, before they pay.
- Payment is held until the owner approves. After access, teams have 7 days to check the data against the listing and their query results.

## Who it is for

- Anyone who owns a dataset AI companies need. Certificates work today for tabular data, databases and text; footage, audio and 3D can show a profile now, and certificates follow.
- AI companies that need data for training and evaluation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aseryx.xyz/)
- [Datasets](https://aseryx.xyz/datasets): profiles their owners approve, each saying whether it carries a quality certificate
- [Benchmarks](https://aseryx.xyz/benchmarks): how ready each dataset is for training, scored by one formula per domain
- [For AI companies](https://aseryx.xyz/buyers)
- [Score preview](https://aseryx.xyz/appraisal): a preview of a dataset's quality score that never sets a price
- [Blog](https://aseryx.xyz/blog)

## Dataset profiles approved by their owners

- [Synchronized Multi-Angle Driving Footage](https://aseryx.xyz/datasets/synchronized-multi-angle-driving-footage): DrivingFootage.com's driving video, every angle in sync
- [OHADA Business Law](https://aseryx.xyz/datasets/ohada-business-law): NGOMEN BISIL Law firm's lawyer-written legal reasoning, in French
- [European Architecture and Heritage Photos](https://aseryx.xyz/datasets/european-architecture-and-heritage-photos): Costantino Anikin's captioned photographs of European buildings

More profiles open on the catalog as their owners finish their review.
